text: Underway in this crucial clash!
Tortoise calls to hold the defensive line early on.
Tortoise loses footing in midfield.
CR-7000 steps in with a crunching challenge to leave Hare sprawling deep in terracotta territory.
GOAL! Zidroid tucks it away from close range! The league leaders strike early, Real Machina lead 1-0!
Hare responds instantly, motoring through the centre into the attacking third.
GOAL! Hare finishes it right on the goal mouth! AFC Fable level it at 1-1!
Hare is clean through on goal!
Charging straight down the middle, Hare has the goal at their mercy.
Agony for Fable! Hare drags the shot just wide of the target from the right channel.
Terracotta shirts applying relentless pressure now, penning Real Machina deep inside their own defensive zone.
Zidroid breaks out, carrying the magenta ball along the right flank.
Inches wide from point-blank range!
GOAL! Zidroid will not be denied twice, poking home from the goal mouth to make it 2-1 to Real Machina!
Tortoise calls for patience in midfield, signaling intent to take control of the loose ball.
Fable teammates collide in a heap!
Hare bounces up and flattens CR-7000 with a robust tackle!
GOAL! Tortoise turns it in right on the line! It's 2-2!
Zidroid takes a tumble in the centre circle without a challenge in sight. Plenty of time to reboot while play develops.
GOAL! Disaster for Real Machina as CR-7000 turns the ball into the back of their own net! A shocking own goal puts AFC Fable ahead 3-2!
Tortoise signals to cover back.
Hare breaks clear down the left touchline, clean through with nobody in white able to cut off the angle!
Hare edges inside towards goal.
Fable are completely hemming Real Machina inside their defensive area.
Rattled into the corner, and the push-panel fires the magenta sphere back into the mix with tremendous force!
Hare leaves Zidroid grounded with a powerful dispossessing challenge in the defensive third.
CR-7000 levels Tortoise with a firm tackle high up the pitch, winning back vital territory for Real Machina.
Hare demands the ball immediately!
Zidroid comes sliding in with authority, flooring Hare out on the right flank before they can pull the trigger.
Hare loses balance and topples.
CR-7000 suddenly breaks through down the left flank, entirely unopposed!
GOAL! Zidroid arrives on cue to tap home from point-blank range! Real Machina are back on level terms, it is 3-3 with seconds left in the half!
CR-7000 charges down the right!
Rattles just past the upright!
GOAL! What a turnaround right on the stroke of the interval! CR-7000 snatches the lead back for Real Machina, making it 4-3!
That brings a frantic first half to a close. Seven goals already, and Real Machina edge it 4-3 over AFC Fable as the teams recharge.
Hare urgently alerts Tortoise to the danger, claiming responsibility for dealing with a fast-moving ball near their goal line.
A dreadful mix-up between the terracotta pair sends Tortoise clattering to the turf!
Now the white shirts collide! Zidroid hits the deck after bumping into CR-7000!
CR-7000 also takes a fall!
Real Machina suffocating their opponents now.
Smashed centimetres wide of the post!
Hare is barking out instructions once again, demanding the next strike on goal.
Tortoise finds acres of space and bursts clean through on the counter-attack!
Tortoise rumbles purposefully forward into the danger area, zeroing in on the Real Machina net.
Oh, by the barest of margins! Tortoise's effort shaves the paint of the post, just a tenth of a metre from an equaliser with three minutes to go!
CR-7000 signals total control over on the right flank, looking to calm the tempo down.
Fable pressing furiously with time slipping away!
Rebound off the wall, and the mechanical corner panel blasts the ball right back into the danger zone!
CR-7000 drives forward through midfield to relieve the intense pressure.
CR-7000 breaks away clean through on goal on the left channel!
GOAL! Zidroid seals the two-goal cushion! A clinical finish into the bottom corner makes it 5-3 to Real Machina with under two minutes remaining!
Tortoise calls to retain composure at the back, steadying the rhythm as the final minute approaches.
Zidroid surges towards the net!
GOAL! Zidroid strikes again with absolute ruthlessness! Real Machina stretch their lead to 6-3 in the dying seconds!
A brief pause in the centre as the clock ticks down. Real Machina are showing exactly why they sit atop the league table, managing the final moments with seasoned precision.
GOAL! Zidroid adds an emphatic exclamation mark in the final seconds! It's 7-3 to Real Machina!
Hare leaves Zidroid on the deck.
Full time: Real Machina win 7-3; join us at 12:00 London for Singularity United against Manus FC.
